reason: The first bag has no fee and I can hand back anything wrong, so I'll try it once or twice for the packaged things and the cleaning stuff. I keep choosing my own vegetables and meat anyway, so it doesn't touch what I care about.
objection: Another fee on top of my groceries. If the saving is only half of the bulk difference, it may not even cover the $1.25 a bag, and I don't know this neighbour yet.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing on the slip, on my first bag, that I really saved more than the bag fee, and hearing from a neighbour in the village WhatsApp group that the receipts match.
